messages.subject: Stochastic indexing bug in 0.7.0
parts:
Thanks y'all for the great programming work.

I just updated nimble on my laptop while working remotely this week, and hadn't gotten updating it on my workstation. I am currently fitting some event time survival models run along the age axis.  I have a stochastic index, i.e. randomly sampling ages which then goes into a correction for the time axis in these models. Anyways, I received an error during compilation while running nimbleMCMC().

"There an unknown problem looking for variables ____________ blah blah___index.time[1,2],....,index.time[250,250]______________(listing all the stochastic nodes in the model). "

Running the exact same model and everythin in 0.6-12 on my workstation, I received no such error. The only difference is the nimble version.
Oh, and working in R 3.4.4, and planning to not update until after this analysis is completed.

Dear Alison,

Good timing.  I'm about to send a message to the list about this issue and a GitHub branch we have available that should fix it.  Hold on a moment and please try the fix.  If it still doesn't work, let us know.  I don't think it has to do with stochastic indexing.  I think it just looks that way in your particular case.

-Perry
